description: Cut polygon regions out of a character PNG for parts-based rigging (cutout animation). Writes each part as <name>.png plus base.png (source with parts erased) into outDir, and returns each part's bbox for placement. Use with riv_create: images per part + groups as pivots.

outDir.description: Directory to write part PNGs into

keepInBase.description: Don't erase this region from base.png

polygon.description: Polygon vertices in source image pixel coords

name: riv_slice_image
title: Slice a PNG into parts for rigging
